svg.title: Alex Földvári - Frontend / Full-Stack Developer, Zürich
svg.desc: Header card for Alex Földvári. Left: the AF monogram wordmark with the tagline Develop, Automate, Grow, the statement "I design, build and ship web products end to end.", the role "Frontend / Full-Stack Developer", and the location "Zürich, Switzerland". Right: an abstract browser and phone wireframe of a web product that draws itself and fills in once, then stays complete.
